April 2026 CanShare newsletter

Stay up-to-date with the latest developments across the CanShare programme and other data improvement work underway across the sector to improve the accessibility of cancer data. The April newsletter includes updates on:

  • An AI-assisted Structured Anatomical Pathology (ASAP) application pilot that went live in Waitematā, Christchurch, and Dunedin
  • New content in the April SNOMED CT New Zealand release and the Radiation Oncology Collection
  • The Breast Cancer Foundation National Register has reached a significant SNOMED CT coding milestone across key clinical domains, supported by the launch of their new register system.
  • A new Cancer Information Hub landing page on thois website is being developed
  • how to book for the ACT-NOW regimen workshops and where to find a new set of supportive care guidelines
  • three new people who joined the CanShare Data & Analytics team.

Read the full details in our April Data and Analytics newsletter on the CanShare web section.

The State of Cancer in New Zealand 2025

On Thursday 11 December 2025, we published The State of Cancer in New Zealand 2025, providing an updated snapshot of progress in cancer control over the last 5 years. The report shows New Zealand continues to make encouraging progress in key areas of prevention, early detection and treatment.

Where to go for help

  • Emergencies: Dial 111 (for ambulance, fire or police)
  • Healthline: Dial 0800 611 116
  • Need to talk? Free call or text 1737
  • Mental health crisis: Emergency contact numbers
